title: ADR-0006 §5 boot continuity — MEASURED on hardware
procedure: purchase amount=2 sats -> ISSUED, allotment 2000, session_active true
SIGKILL the module (kill -9; no shutdown hooks, no graceful drain)
restart the same binary against the same TOLLGATE_STATE_DB

state: Authenticated (restored by the MODULE, client did nothing)

verdict: PASS — the paid session, its allotment, live usage, and the gate all survive a hard kill and restart
notes: This was the last UNVERIFIED item of ADR-0006. All §1-§5 decisions are now implemented AND measured.

Sessions that expired/exhausted while down are closed at open() and deliberately NOT re-authed (measured in PR #49's sweep test).
